The repo copy ([SMOKE-CHECKLIST.md](https://github.com/VTSTech/D2VP-QoL/blob/main/SMOKE-CHECKLIST.md)) is the canonical reference: the per-round build stamp and field history live there, and any round that adds or changes a check re-runs `tools/gen-smoke-issue-template.py` and commits both.

**Verdict:** fill in the Verdict section at the bottom when the pass is done.

**Known-fail — skip, don't burn time:** Necro skeleton spawn tint (issue #8). R51 spawn-polarity fix is pending re-verify; symptom = own raised skeletons spawn yellow and (per R51 theory) should never re-tint. One useful datum for the next round: raise a skeleton and note whether it *ever* re-tints (e.g. after a roster-update event) or stays yellow forever — "never re-tints" would falsify the R51 theory.

## C. Vanilla+ features (needs `d2vp.ini`)

- [ ] **7. Auto-create:** with no `d2vp.ini` present, first run creates it (documented, all-defaults) and the game plays vanilla.
- [ ] **8. `alt_toggle`:** each Alt press flips ground labels on/off. Click a *label* to pick up. Labels stay latched after you click something. **R58 regression guard (issue #15):** with labels latched, hover an item's label once, then move the cursor to EMPTY ground well away from any item and walk-click — the click must **walk** (no pickup, no walk-to-loot). Then: click the item's *sprite* still picks up; click a *label* still picks up; a combat click (monster under cursor) still attacks; `alt_toggle=0` untouched. If a click-away ever picks up or walks to loot again, the R58 stale-clear has regressed.
- [ ] **9. `auto_gold`:** walk over a gold pile → auto-collected. Negative checks: does **not** move your character, does **not** fire mid-attack, picks up **gold only** (drop a gem, walk over — gem stays).
- [ ] **10. `globe_persistent`:** HP/MP text above orbs always visible, no hover needed.
- [ ] **11. Hot-reload:** edit `d2vp.ini` while in-game (flip a key) → applies within ~2 s, no restart.
- [ ] **12. `portable_save`:** enabled → save & exit → `.d2s` lands in `<game folder>\save`, re-enters fine.
- [ ] **12b. `item_ilvl` (new in R55, name-suffix presentation R56, bare digits R57, single-space trim R59):** set `item_ilvl=1` → every item tooltip's **name line** reads `Long Sword (12)` — the suffix joins the item name (no separate `Item Level:` line anymore; R55's standalone line is gone; R57 dropped the `ilvl` label word — the bare `(N)` is the ilvl). The suffix renders in the name's own color (gold on a unique, green on a set piece). The gap between the name and `(N)` is exactly **one space** on every item (R59 trim: some string-table names/affix words end with their own space and used to render a double gap). Sanity pairs: an early-act normal drop (small ilvl) vs a late-game unique/rare (large); a **set piece** (second tooltip builder); an **unidentified** item (suffix still shows); gold/potions (suffix shows, harmless). Negative: key off/missing → tooltips exactly as retail; the in-game **Vanilla+ Options** row `Item Level Tooltips` flips it and applies within ~2 s without a restart.

## G. Save → re-enter regression ([issue #19](https://github.com/VTSTech/D2VP-QoL/issues/19), R61 ROOT-CAUGHT + FIXED — FIELD-CONFIRMED 2026-11-01, issue CLOSED)

"Saving a game and then trying to enter a game again crashes the game." **ROOT-CAUGHT R61** (field log 2026-10-31, crash report + d2exe.map): the VP Resolution row's runtime blank-attach mutates the static esc-menu table (`nSubImageCount` 2→3, `szSubImage3Path` stays empty); every game entry re-runs `ESCMENU_Initialize` (0x01 → `InitializeUI`), so init #2 walked the empty third stop and hit the retail fatal `HaltTail(0x501)` = `HALT line=1281` in the field report. The save is irrelevant — ANY second game entry in one process died. R61 degrades both data guards in the loader to marks (empty stop → keep the prior DC6; count out of range → clamp) and guards the type-1 draw site (NULL slot skip + index clamp). One char, two game entries in one process — the fix is proven by NOT crashing:

- [ ] **18. Re-enter (the issue repro, now the fix proof):** boot → enter any game → ~30 s → Save & Exit → same process, select the same char → Play. `d2boot.log` line 1 reads `Vanilla+0.0.6-R62`. **The second entry must load and be playable.** Expected in the log at the second entry: exactly one **`escmenu: video item 1 stop 2 path empty - prior dc6 kept [R61]`** (the Resolution row's synthesized stop skipping its re-load — this mark IS the fix working; the 720p stop survives because the runtime blank DC6 stays in its slot). No `halt report:`/`d2crash-*.txt` may appear. — **CONFIRMED 2026-11-01 (R61 field run, owner: "R61 Confirmed fixes #19"):** the second entry loaded and played — issue #19 CLOSED. Keep as a per-build regression check.
- [ ] **19. Resolution row still whole (feature regression guard):** in game 2, open the in-game menu → Options → Video → Resolution: **three stops — 640x480 / 800x600 / Vanilla Plus 1280x720** — the 720p stop selectable and the "1280x720" label visible (the blank slot survived the re-init). Switching stops applies as before. If the 720p stop is missing or the label is blank, send the log — the slot-keep path misfired. — **No regression reported in the R61 confirmation run (2026-11-01).** Keep as a per-build regression check.
- [ ] **20. Esc menu + roster watches unchanged:** in-game ESC menu draws every row (the type-1 rows — 3DSound/EAX/NPCSpeech/AutoMap — draw their toggle images; a NULL slot would now be skipped, not drawn, not crashed). `roster heal:` cap marks during load are the SEPARATE standing corruptor watch (they fired in this run's session 1 too — the R54 shape) — if they appear, send the log; the R60 probes (`roster: clear lists …`, `roster state: …`) stay live around them. — **No regression reported in the R61 confirmation run (2026-11-01); the corruptor watch stays armed.** Keep as a per-build regression check.

## J. Item tooltip — elemental/poison zero fix ([issue #16](https://github.com/VTSTech/D2VP-QoL/issues/16), R84)

Items could drop with a mod line reading **"0 poison damage over 0 seconds"** or **"+0 Cold Damage"** on 'of Frost' gear. Root cause (display side, one function): the single-value branches of the item-stat tooltip formatter (fire/lightning/magic/cold/poison) called the wide-string formatter **without the numeric varargs**, so any roll whose range collapses to min==max printed stack residue (zeros in our builds) instead of the value. 'of Frost' (weapons) rolls `cold-max 1..2` with `cold-min` fixed at 1 — every drop that rolls a 1 collapsed; poison ranges collapse through the length rounding (and zero-length poison content lands in the same branch). Fix passes the same values the range branches pass; the item's stats were never wrong — this was tooltip-only.

- [ ] **37. Cold tooltip:** hover any cold-damage magic weapon — prefer an **'of Frost'** one (low level, common drop): the cold line shows real numbers — `Adds 1-2 Cold Damage` (or any higher family's range), or a single value `Adds 1 Cold Damage` when the roll collapsed to min==max — **never `Adds 0 Cold Damage` / `+0`**. Also eyeball fire/lightning/magic damage lines while you're at it (same fix family).
- [ ] **38. Poison tooltip:** hover any poison-damage item (an 'of Blight'/'of Venom' weapon, a poison charm, or a poison unique): the line shows real values over real seconds — `Adds N-M Poison Damage over T Seconds` (or the single-value shape `Adds N Poison Damage over T Seconds`) — **never `0 Poison Damage over 0 Seconds`**. If a zero/zero line ever still appears, screenshot the item — that would be a genuinely length-0 poison mod (generation-side data, a different follow-up), not the tooltip bug.

## Evidence to keep if anything breaks

| Artifact | Comes from | Tells us |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `d2boot.log` | `d2vp.exe` | build self-ID (which round you actually ran) |
| `d2crash-<date>-<time>.txt` | `d2vp.exe` (auto-written next to the exe; hangwatch dumps one after 12 s) | symbolised crashed module/function/offset |
| `glide3x.log` | glide3xvk wrapper | frame, preset, chain state; whether the faulting thread was wrapper code |

A crash without both artifacts cannot be attributed — attach all to the issue.
